title: licence-to-export — replication package: Does Licensed Production Build Arms Exporters? Evidence from 75 Years of Major-Arms Transfers
description: Code, coding rules and derived panels for a study of whether licensed production of major conventional arms brings forward a recipient state's first export in the same weapon category, using the SIPRI Arms Transfers Database 1950-2025. Raw SIPRI, Maddison and World Bank files are not redistributed; the README gives extraction details.
